fact: The Central Bank of Lesotho, with leading banks, introduced localized POS transactions under the LeSwitch national switch from 11 May 2025, after ATM localization in October 2024, with all local card transactions handled in-country by early 2025.
source_slug: 2025-05-20 LeSwitch expands to localized POS transactions (Central Bank of Lesotho)

fact: The Lesotho Times reports the Central Bank of Lesotho, with four commercial banks, launched local POS transactions on the National Payment Switch LeSwitch on 11 May 2025, after instant payments (2022) and ATM (piloted Oct 2024 to Feb 2025).
The Central Bank of Lesotho leads LeSwitch, whose fast-payments phase was launched on 20 March 2024, per Standard Lesotho Bank.
source_slug: 2024-10-08 Lesotho National Payment Switch (LeSwitch) — Standard Lesotho Bank press release

fact: The finance minister moved the Payment System Bill, 2025 to second reading in the National Assembly; it would repeal the Payment Systems Act 2014, license all payment service providers under one law and give the Central Bank of Lesotho powers to oversee the national payment system.

The Ministry of Finance told Lesotho's parliamentary committee that the Payment Systems Bill, presented 2 May 2025, would give the Central Bank of Lesotho powers to supervise national payment systems and license non-bank payment entities.
